sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored - GitHub
sources.snippet: Check GPU offloading: ollama ps — if you see a CPU/GPU split, the model is partially on CPU Force all layers to GPU: Already set in Modelfile.mac (num_gpu 999), but verify with ollama show qwen3.8:27b-uncensored Reduce context: QWEN_NUM_CTX=4096 node examples/chat.cjs "test" — smaller KV cache = less memory Switch to MLX: node bin/install.cjs --mlx — 30-50% faster on Apple Silicon Close ...

sources.title: orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B tensor-level abliterated, vision tower and MTP head untouched. 0% over-refusal on XSTest, 0-6% refusal across the A/B suite, no measurable capability loss. Full mmproj vision, tool calling and thinking, 262K context.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored: Hardware Requirements and LM Studio Setup
sources.snippet: The community-built Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored HauhauCS Aggressive release removes many of the refusal behaviors found in the base model while retaining Qwen3.8-27B's reasoning, agentic, image, and video capabilities. The GGUF release also includes MTP support for faster generation in compatible runtimes.
